# Nano-GICP

Vendored, unmodified `include/`, `src/`, and `LICENSE` from
https://github.com/engcang/nano_gicp at commit
`b21e79edcceb7c6e86ec0dfec90f451b796b683a`.

The upstream catkin build is not used. The parent ament package compiles the
two upstream translation units with PCL and OpenMP. Original copyright and
license notices, including embedded BSD notices, are preserved in the files.
